// divguard:path ai/openai.go

package ai

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"log"
)

type chunk struct{ Text string }

// parseSSE reproduces AI-08: a corrupt chunk is skipped and the turn still
// ends as a success with its text missing.
func parseSSE(r io.Reader, emit func(chunk)) {
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(r)
	for sc.Scan() {
		var c chunk
		if err := json.Unmarshal(sc.Bytes(), &c); err != nil { // want
			continue
		}
		emit(c)
	}
}

func parseAnthropic(lines []string, emit func(chunk)) {
	for _, line := range lines {
		var c chunk
		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &c) != nil { // want
			continue
		}
		var err error
		err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &c)
		if err != nil { // want
			log.Printf("bad chunk: %v", err.Error())
			continue
		}
		_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &c) // want
		emit(c)
	}
}
